relevance.rationale: Foundational paper introducing multiplicative Jucys-Murphy elements in type-A Iwahori-Hecke algebras over arbitrary rings and characterizing Z(H_n(q)) via symmetric polynomials.

keyResults.statement: Multiplicative Jucys-Murphy elements commute pairwise and every elementary symmetric polynomial in them lies in the center of the Iwahori-Hecke algebra over any commutative ground ring.
keyResults.useForFolio: Backs BraidKnotOctonion/HeckeJucysMurphySymmetricCenter.lean discharging bean qou-u9o1 over [CommRing R].
